prepare.command: mkdir -p .tmp .state .evidence .cache/go-build; cp -R /opt/steward/go-build/. .cache/go-build/; for component in provider-bridge runtime/javascript guest-browser web; do if test -d /opt/steward/deps/"$component"/node_modules; then cp -R /opt/steward/deps/"$component"/node_modules "$component"/; fi; done

doctor.command: test "$(go env GOVERSION)" = go1.26.11 && test "$(node --version)" = v24.21.0 && node scripts/setup_browser.cjs

checks.name: build
checks.requirement: 当前确切候选能在已固定的 Linux Go 工具链与依赖中构建，并实际执行新二进制的模型桥协议版本入口。构建不代表行为验收。

checks.name: frontend-contracts
checks.requirement: 当前候选的生成资产与前端行为约束保持一致。此检查不代替端到端浏览器或人工审阅。
checks.command: npm run check --prefix web && npm test --prefix web

checks.name: policy-boundaries
checks.requirement: 实际编译依赖保持项目政策与资源权威分离，网络导入和领域依赖的错误变体必须被拒绝。
